correctness.rationale: An S5 world is described by support S of its equivalence class and local colour t in S. Singleton propositional colour tests and Δ of these tests separate every realized pair (S,t); induction shows arbitrary nested Δ cannot distinguish more. Thus Z=sum_S |S|I_S. Inclusion-exclusion for surjective r-tuples supplies p_(r,s), and occupancy over m iid classes supplies the exact law/expectation. When m,r->infinity and q fixed, p_(r,s)~(s/q)^r and different support sizes have exponentially separated intensities. Mixed multinomial falling-factorial moments show independent Poisson counts at any one finite positive critical s, yielding shifted scaled Binomial. All other supports vanish/appear. Boundedness of Z and disjoint expectation plateau intervals prove distribution convergence iff expectation convergence iff each intensity extended-converges. Independently enumerated exact small q=2,4 colourings and matched rational dynamic-programming occupancy laws; tests do not establish asymptotics.
